title: Kirb's Create
description: Just a thing I'm slowly working on now. PVP focused I guess CBC and SCguns 2 included. :)
body:
# I don't really know how to describe this ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯
## But here is my best atempt at summary
Kirb's Create (still in development) is a modpack that plans to integrate CBC, Valkyren skies and SCguns into survival. With plans of it being a faction war/automation pack meant for smaller groups eg.: 3v3 but it should also work at scale.

I am developing this pack for a friend group but I thought that other people might enjoy this so im uploading it here.

## Some of the core mods in this pack:
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons)
- [Valkyren Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/valkyrien-skies)
- [Scorched Guns 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/scorched-guns-2)
- [Create: Diesel Generators](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-diesel-generators)
- [Crate: Metalurgy](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-metallurgy)
- [Create: Tank Defenses](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-tank-defenses)
## And the most important mod of all:
- [Blåhaj Expanded](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcr_blahaj)
